County PIA instructions require requests directly to the custodian: Public Works Department Head, Nueces County Courthouse, 901 Leopard Street, Floor 1 Room 103, Corpus Christi TX 78401. County Attorney-only submission is not the Public Works intake; use the published routing instructions and confirm current electronic submission contact. No public complete case export confirmed; request existing electronic records if maintained, not a new inspection or analysis.
